license_required.quote: Only a dentist licensed to practice under this chapter may practice as a dentist in this state, unless otherwise stated in this chapter.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant provides references that indicate the applicant is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Medicine or Doctor of Dental Surgery from an American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school
degree_required.quote: The applicant has graduated from an American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school, having obtained a doctor of dental medicine or a doctor of dental surgery degree

accrediting_body.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA)
accrediting_body.quote: graduated from an American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school

degree_level.quote: having obtained a doctor of dental medicine or a doctor of dental surgery degree

school_approval_basis.quote: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school

credential_pegged.quote: The applicant has graduated from an American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school, having obtained a doctor of dental medicine or a doctor of dental surgery degree

required.quote: Any person desiring to practice as a dentist may obtain a license to practice as a dentist if the applicant satisfies each of the following criteria

experience_source.quote: Any person desiring to practice as a dentist may obtain a license to practice as a dentist if the applicant satisfies each of the following criteria

exams.name: Standardized national comprehensive examination
exams.quote: The applicant has passed a standardized national comprehensive examination approved by the board

exams.name: Clinical regional or national examination
exams.notes: Must be passed within five years preceding date of application; state examination deemed equivalent also accepted
exams.quote: Within five years preceding the date of application, the applicant has passed a clinical regional or national examination approved by the board or a state examination or examinations that the board deems equivalent

exams.name: State laws and rules examination
exams.notes: Examination concerning state laws and rules relating to dentistry
exams.quote: The applicant has passed an examination concerning the state laws and rules relating to dentistry

interval_years.quote: As a condition of annual renewal of a license or registration, each licensee or registrant shall, on or before the first day of July each year, transmit to the board

required.quote: Every five years of licensure or registration, each licensee or registrant shall provide the board evidence, of a nature suitable to the board that a licensee or registrant has attended, or participated in an amount of board approved continuing education or continuing competency as shall be required by the board.

period_years.quote: Every five years of licensure or registration, each licensee or registrant shall provide the board evidence

available.quote: Any person licensed in another state desiring to practice as a dentist may obtain a license to practice as a dentist if the applicant satisfies each of the following criteria

requirements.value: Applicant must have graduated from a CODA-accredited US dental school with a DDS or DMD, be currently active with at least 3,000 dental clinical hours within the preceding five years, passed a standardized national comprehensive exam and a clinical regional or national exam, currently hold a valid license in another state, have no pending disciplinary actions, the other state's licensure requirements must be the same or higher than SD's, provide good moral character references, and pass the SD laws and rules examination.
requirements.quote: The licensure requirements in the other state are in the judgment of the board the same as or higher than those required by this state

national_association.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation
national_association.quote: graduated from an American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation accredited United States dental school

regulatory_model.quote: Only a dentist licensed to practice under this chapter may practice as a dentist in this state, unless otherwise stated in this chapter.

credential_type.quote: Issue a license to practice as a dentist or a dental hygienist to an applicant who has met the licensure standards of this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: Each person who practices as, attempts to practice as, or purports to be a dentist, dental hygienist, dental radiographer, or registered dental assistant in this state without being licensed or without being registered for that purpose or without being exempted from this chapter is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Any dentist who implies, purports or leads a patient to believe that the dentist is a dental specialist without meeting the educational requirements set forth in this chapter, is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Each person who practices as, attempts to practice as, or purports to be a dentist, dental hygienist, dental radiographer, or registered dental assistant in this state without being licensed or without being registered for that purpose or without being exempted from this chapter is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting a license, certificate, or diploma obtained by fraud or deception or false statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the board any license, certificate, or diploma which was obtained by fraud or deception practiced in passing a required examination or which was obtained by the giving of false statements or information on applying for the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illegally or fraudulently obtaining a license or registration by any deception or false statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illegally, fraudulently, or wrongfully obtaining a license or registration or renewal required by this chapter by the use of any means, devices, deceptions, or help in passing any examination or by making false statements or misrepresentations in any applications or information presented

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud or deception during the course of the applicant's education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in fraud or deception during the course of the applicant's education

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud or material deception in the course of professional services or activities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in fraud or material deception in the course of professional services or activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, criminal offense arising out of the practice of dentistry, or criminal offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of a criminal offense arising out of the practice of dentistry, or conviction of a criminal offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing professional incompetence by a dental hygienist or dental auxiliary under supervision due to deliberate or negligent act or failure to act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing professional incompetence by a dental hygienist or dental auxiliary working under his or her supervision due to a deliberate or negligent act or acts or failure to act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of dental services to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of dental services to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, assisting, or enabling an unlicensed person to practice as a dentist or dental hygienist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, assisting, or enabling in any manner an unlicensed person to practice as a dentist or dental hygienist or a person that does not hold a registration to practice as a registered dental assistant or dental radiographer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting, enabling, or permitting a dental hygienist or dental auxiliary to perform unauthorized dental services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting, enabling, or permitting a dental hygienist or dental auxiliary to perform any dental service other than those authorized by this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing dental services other than those authorized by this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing dental services other than those authorized by this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate safety and sanitary conditions for a dental clinic
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain adequate safety and sanitary conditions for a dental clinic in accordance with the standards set forth in this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false or misleading advertising of a dental business or dental services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false or misleading advertising or advertising of a dental business or dental services in which untruthful or improbable statements are made or which are calculated to mislead or deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or paying commissions to persons who send patients for treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as permitted by chapter 47-12, dividing fees with, promising to pay a part of a fee to, or to pay a commission to any dentist or any other person who sends patients for treatment or operation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use or drug addiction affecting the licensee's practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Substance use or drug addiction, calculated in the opinion of the board to affect the licensee's or registrant's practice of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing narcotics or habit-forming drugs in quantities or circumstances not for legitimate medicinal purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing intoxicants, narcotics, barbiturates, or other habit-forming drugs to any person in quantities and under circumstances making it apparent to the board that the prescription was not made for legitimate medicinal purposes related to the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to practice after sustaining a physical or mental disability rendering practice potentially harmful
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing to practice after sustaining any physical or mental disability which renders the further practice of a licensee's or registrant's profession potentially harmful or dangerous

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with state or federal laws on keeping records regarding narcotics and habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with state or federal laws on keeping records regarding possessing and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying dental records of a patient or official records regarding narcotics or dental treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying the dental records of a patient or any official record regarding possession and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs or regarding any phase of dental treatment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within the dentist-patient relationship to engage a patient in sexual activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The exercise of influence within the dentist-patient relationship for the purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual harassment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual harassment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing or prescribing dental services or treatments which are inappropriate or unnecessary
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing or prescribing dental services or treatments which are inappropriate or unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any practice or conduct constituting a danger to the health, welfare, or safety of the public or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any practice or conduct which tends to constitute a danger to the health, welfare, or safety of the public or patients or engaging in conduct which is unbecoming of a dentist, dental hygienist, dental radiographer or registered dental assistant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board for a violation that is also a violation under this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board or the licensing board of the District of Columbia if the violation is also a violation of this chapter or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Not reporting to the board discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not reporting to the board discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board or the licensing board of the District of Columbia

disciplinary_grounds.description: Not reporting to the board a conviction of any felony, criminal offense arising out of dentistry, or offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not reporting to the board a conviction of any criminal offense of the grade of felony, any conviction of a criminal offense arising out of the practice of dentistry, or one in connection with any criminal offense involving moral turpitude.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery and the prescribing of drugs, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity or its adjacent or associated tissues and structures of the maxillofacial area, and their impact on the human body.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry," the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery and the prescribing of drugs, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity or its adjacent or associated tissues and structures of the maxillofacial area, and their impact on the human body

methods_authorized.quote: the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including surgery and the prescribing of drugs, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human oral cavity

drug_authority.value: A dentist may prescribe or administer drugs only in connection with dental related ailments or conditions.
drug_authority.quote: A dentist may prescribe or administer drugs only in connection with dental related ailments or conditions.

specialist_license_available.quote: "Dental specialist," a dentist in a specialty recognized by the board that has graduated from a postdoctoral specialty program recognized and approved by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision," the supervision of a dental hygienist or registered dental assistant requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, a dentist remain in the dental clinic while the procedure is performed, and before dismissal of the patient a dentist approve the work performed by the dental hygienist or registered dental assistant

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "Collaborative agreement," a written agreement between a supervising dentist and a dental hygienist authorizing the preventive and therapeutic services that may be performed by the dental hygienist under collaborative supervision

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: The management, ownership, or operation of a business, corporation, organization, or entity through which dentistry, as defined in this chapter, is offered or provided to the public

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Technicians, when not working under the supervision of a dentist, may not provide for dental patients' use any prosthetic appliances, materials, or devices which are inserted in the human oral cavity unless ordered by a dentist.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry," the practice of dentistry where the patient and the dentist are not in the same physical location, and which utilizes the exchange of clinical information and images over remote distances.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A technician or dental laboratory shall maintain a record of work orders for a period of two years.

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.item: Pediatric General Anesthesia / Deep Sedation Endorsement

scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.quote: "Direct supervision," the supervision of a dental hygienist or registered dental assistant requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, a dentist remain in the dental clinic while the procedure is performed, and before dismissal of the patient a dentist approve the work performed by the dental hygienist or registered dental assistant

"Indirect supervision," the supervision of a dental hygienist or registered dental assistant requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures and a dentist be in the dental clinic while the procedures are performed by the registered dental assistant or dental hygienist

"General supervision," the supervision of a dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures to be carried out, and that the patient to be treated is a patient of record of the supervising dentist

scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.item: Advanced practice / collaborative practice (no supervising dentist required)
scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.quote: "Collaborative supervision," the supervision of a dental hygienist requiring a collaborative agreement between a supervising dentist and a dental hygienist
